answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 34 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The fable register is checked at draw time, lotus lists the eligible set, and opal seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 34 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The bill scales 32 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
